## Core Services
1. General Contracting & Construction (المقاولات العامة والإنشاءات): Residential villas, commercial structures, thermal/waterproofing insulation.
2. Finishing & Interior Decor (التشطيبات والديكور الداخلي): High-end plasterboard, painting, ceramic and porcelain installation.
3. Electromechanical Systems (MEP): Electrical infrastructure, plumbing, sanitation networks.
4. Air Conditioning Services (صيانة وتركيب التكييف): Split, central AC installation, maintenance, gas refill, duct cleaning.
5. Professional Cleaning Services (خدمات النظافة الاحترافية): Deep cleaning for villas, post-construction cleanup, steam carpet and sofa cleaning.
6. Floor Grinding & Polishing (جلي وتلميع الأرضيات): Marble, granite, and ceramic polishing and restoration.
7. Pest & Rodent Control (مكافحة الحشرات والقوارض): Safe and certified public health pest eradication.
8. Furniture Relocation & Assembly (نقل وتغليف الأثاث والعفش): Safe transport, dismantling, packaging, and reassembly.
